configure_train_pipeline: configure the COCO caption training pipeline with random resized crop, flip, and caption cleaning steps
configure_test_pipeline: configure the COCO caption test pipeline with fixed 384x384 resize and pack inputs steps
configure_train_dataloader: configure the COCO caption training dataloader with batch size 32 and Karpathy train annotations
configure_val_dataloader: configure the COCO caption validation dataloader with batch size 16 and Karpathy val annotations
configure_data_preprocessor: configure the multi-modal data preprocessor with ImageNet mean and std normalization values
